# design-brainstorm

Use this when the team needs to brainstorm and decide on an architecture.

## How to run the session

Start by understanding the problem. Ask clarifying questions, then discuss the
constraints with the group. Consider the tradeoffs of each option and reason
about what the team actually values.

For every proposed approach, evaluate it honestly. Assess the risks, weigh the
maintenance burden against the delivery speed, and interpret how well it fits
the existing system. Critique your own favourite idea as hard as the others.

When you brainstorm alternatives, do not anchor on the first idea. Explore the
space, prioritize the options that best balance simplicity and flexibility, and
choose deliberately rather than by default.

## Recommending a direction

Once you understand the landscape, summarize what you learned. Explain the
reasoning behind your recommendation, clarify the assumptions, and negotiate
the remaining disagreements. Prefer the approach you can justify, and be ready
to reconsider if someone surfaces a constraint you had not evaluated.

Judgment is the whole job here. There is nothing to run and nothing to execute;
the value is entirely in how well you think through the decision.
